paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging and BLEU scores for different consistency approaches. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 16 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2. A purple line, marked with circle symbols, represents “Consistency-CE”, starting at approximately 22 at an average lagging of 0, increasing to approximately 27 at an average lagging of 7, with a steady upward trend. A dark blue line, marked with square symbols, represents “Inconsistency-CE”, starting at approximately 20 at an average lagging of 0, increasing to approximately 25 at an average lagging of 7, with a generally upward trend. A light blue dashed line, marked with triangle symbols, represents “Inconsistency-CE-MP”, starting at approximately 22 at an average lagging of 0, increasing to approximately 27 at an average lagging of 7, with a generally upward trend. A red line, marked with star symbols, represents “Consistency-Bi”, starting at approximately 23 at an average lagging of 0, increasing to approximately 28 at an average lagging of 7, with a steady upward trend.
